title: HP TET TGT Arts · June 2022 (previous year questions)
description: Questions asked in the HP TET TGT (Arts) exam of the June 2022 session (held on 7 August 2022), with answers checked against a published solved paper and independently verified. Not the complete paper.

questions.text: Who developed Psychoanalysis?
questions.textHi: मनोविश्लेषणवाद का विकास किसने किया?
questions.explanation: Sigmund Freud founded psychoanalysis. (Q1 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-1.html
questions.explanationHi: सिगमंड फ्रायड ने मनोविश्लेषणवाद का विकास किया।

questions.text: Which of these is not a type of long term memory?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा दीर्घकालिक स्मृति का प्रकार नहीं है?
questions.explanation: Working memory is a short-term system; declarative, episodic and semantic memory are long-term. (Q2 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-1.html
questions.explanationHi: कार्यकारी स्मृति अल्पकालिक होती है; घोषणात्मक, घटनापरक और आर्थी स्मृति दीर्घकालिक हैं।

questions.text: Which method is not a Projective method for Personality measurement?
questions.textHi: व्यक्तित्व परीक्षण का इनमें से कौन-सी प्रक्षेपी विधि नहीं है?
questions.explanation: A questionnaire is a self-report (non-projective) method; TAT, Rorschach and sentence completion are projective. (Q4 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-1.html
questions.explanationHi: प्रश्नावली आत्म-रिपोर्ट विधि है, प्रक्षेपी नहीं; TAT, रोर्शा और वाक्य-पूर्ति प्रक्षेपी विधियाँ हैं।

questions.text: Which of the following is most essential component of experimental method?
questions.textHi: निम्न में से कौन-सा प्रयोगात्मक विधि का सर्वाधिक आवश्यक अवयव है?
questions.explanation: Control of conditions (variables) is the essence of the experimental method. (Q5 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-1.html
questions.explanationHi: परिस्थितियों (चरों) पर नियंत्रण प्रयोगात्मक विधि का मूल तत्व है।

questions.text: Filling new information into existing schemes is known as -
questions.textHi: प्रचलित योजनाओं में नई जानकारी जोड़ने को किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: In Piaget's theory, fitting new information into existing schemes is assimilation. (Q6 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-1.html
questions.explanationHi: पियाजे के अनुसार नई जानकारी को मौजूदा स्कीमा में समाहित करना आत्मसात्करण है।

questions.text: The conditioned Stimulus in Pavlov's conditioning is -
questions.textHi: पावलव के अनुबन्धन सिद्धान्त में अनुबंधित उद्दीपक है
questions.explanation: The bell was the neutral stimulus that became the conditioned stimulus after pairing with food. (Q7 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-1.html
questions.explanationHi: घंटी भोजन के साथ जोड़े जाने पर अनुबंधित उद्दीपक बन गई।

questions.text: Meaning of Gestalt is
questions.textHi: गेस्टाल्ट का अर्थ है
questions.explanation: Gestalt (German) means a whole form or configuration. (Q8 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-1.html
questions.explanationHi: गेस्टाल्ट (जर्मन शब्द) का अर्थ है समग्र रूप या पूर्ण आकृति।

questions.text: Students of disadvantaged groups Should be taught along with the normal students. It implies -
questions.textHi: वंचित समूहों के विद्यार्थियों को सामान्य विद्यार्थियों के साथ-साथ पढ़ाना चाहिए। इसका अभिप्राय है
questions.explanation: Teaching disadvantaged children together with other children in regular classrooms is inclusive education. (Q10 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-1.html
questions.explanationHi: वंचित बच्चों को सामान्य बच्चों के साथ एक ही कक्षा में पढ़ाना समावेशी शिक्षा है।

questions.text: Which factor is important in human development?
questions.textHi: मानव विकास में कौन-सा कारक महत्वपूर्ण है?
questions.explanation: Development is the product of the interaction of heredity and environment. (Q11 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-2.html
questions.explanationHi: विकास आनुवंशिकता और पर्यावरण की अंतःक्रिया का परिणाम है।

questions.text: "Drive theory" is related with -
questions.textHi: चालक सिद्धान्त (ड्राइव थ्योरी) संबंधित है
questions.explanation: Drive theory (Hull) explains motivation: behaviour is driven to reduce needs. (Q12 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-2.html
questions.explanationHi: चालक सिद्धांत (हल) अभिप्रेरणा की व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text: The capability of understanding and discriminating the feelings and emotions of oneself and others is called -
questions.textHi: स्वयं एवं दूसरों की अनुभूतियों एवं भावों को समझने तथा उनमें विभेद करने की योग्यता को क्या कहते हैं?
questions.explanation: Emotional intelligence is the ability to perceive, understand and discriminate one's own and others' emotions. (Q13 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-2.html
questions.explanationHi: सांवेगिक बुद्धि अपने और दूसरों के संवेगों को पहचानने व समझने की योग्यता है।

questions.text: Who developed "Thematic Apperception Test" (T.A.T.)?
questions.textHi: प्रासंगिक अंतर्बोध परीक्षण (TAT) का निर्माण किसने किया?
questions.explanation: The TAT was developed by Henry Murray and Christiana Morgan (1935). (Q14 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-2.html
questions.explanationHi: TAT का निर्माण हेनरी मरे और क्रिस्टियाना मॉर्गन ने किया।

questions.text: 16-PF is used for measurement of ___
questions.textHi: 16 – PF का प्रयोग ______ के मापन हेतु किया जाता है।
questions.explanation: Cattell's 16 Personality Factor (16-PF) questionnaire measures personality. (Q15 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-2.html
questions.explanationHi: कैटेल का 16-PF प्रश्नावली व्यक्तित्व मापन के लिए है।

questions.text: Who classified Introverts and Extrovert personality?
questions.textHi: अन्तर्मुखी और बहिर्मुखी व्यक्तित्व का वर्गीकरण किसने किया?
questions.explanation: Carl Jung classified personality into introverts and extroverts. (Q16 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-2.html
questions.explanationHi: कार्ल युंग ने व्यक्तित्व को अंतर्मुखी और बहिर्मुखी में बाँटा।

questions.text: Which one of the following can be considered as a contribution of Kohlberg's theory?
questions.textHi: कोहलबर्ग के सिद्धान्त के योगदान के रूप में निम्नलिखित में से किसे माना जाता है?
options: His theory has supported an association between cognitive maturity and moral maturity.
The theory has elaborate testing procedures.
It establishes a clear relationship between moral reasoning and action.
His belief is that children are moral philosophers.
optionsHi: उनके सिद्धान्त ने संज्ञानात्मक परिपक्वता और नैतिक परिपक्वता के बीच एक संबंध का समर्थन किया है।
इस सिद्धान्त में विस्तृत परीक्षण प्रक्रियाएं है।
यह नैतिक तर्क और कार्यवाही के बीच एक स्पष्ट संबंध स्थापित करता है।
उनका विश्वास है कि बच्चे नैतिक दार्शनिक हैं।
questions.explanation: Kohlberg linked moral reasoning stages to cognitive development, supporting a link between cognitive and moral maturity. (Q17 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-2.html
questions.explanationHi: कोहलबर्ग ने नैतिक तर्क के चरणों को संज्ञानात्मक विकास से जोड़ा।

questions.text: Which one of the following is an emotion?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक संवेग है?
questions.explanation: Fear is an emotion; memory and attention are cognitive processes and a stimulus is an external event. (Q18 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-2.html
questions.explanationHi: डर एक संवेग है; स्मृति और ध्यान संज्ञानात्मक प्रक्रियाएँ हैं।

questions.text: Which one of these is first phase of creative thinking?
questions.textHi: सृजनात्मक चिंतन का प्रथम चरण कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Wallas's stages of creative thinking: preparation, incubation, illumination, verification. (Q19 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-2.html
questions.explanationHi: वालास के अनुसार सृजनात्मक चिंतन के चरण: तैयारी, उद्भवन, प्रदीप्ति, सत्यापन।

questions.text: Who propounded the theory of "Trial and Error"?
questions.textHi: “प्रयत्न और त्रुटि” विधि का सिद्धान्त किसने प्रतिपादित किया था?
questions.explanation: E.L. Thorndike gave the trial-and-error theory of learning. (Q20 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-2.html
questions.explanationHi: ई.एल. थॉर्नडाइक ने प्रयत्न और त्रुटि का सिद्धांत दिया।

questions.text: The correct formula to calculate I.Q. is:
questions.textHi: बुद्धि-लब्धि निकालने का सही सूत्र है:
questions.explanation: IQ = (Mental Age ÷ Chronological Age) × 100. (Q21 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-3.html
questions.explanationHi: बुद्धि-लब्धि = (मानसिक आयु ÷ वास्तविक आयु) × 100।

questions.text: Child's tendency to respond similarly to stimuli that are similar to conditioned stimulus is -
questions.textHi: बालक की अनुबंधित उद्दीपक के समान अन्य उद्दीपकों के प्रति समान अनुक्रिया की प्रवृत्ति है –
questions.explanation: Responding similarly to stimuli resembling the conditioned stimulus is stimulus generalisation. (Q22 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-3.html
questions.explanationHi: अनुबंधित उद्दीपक जैसे अन्य उद्दीपकों पर समान अनुक्रिया करना सामान्यीकरण है।

questions.text: Which of the following methods helps to study children with special needs?
questions.textHi: निम्न में से कौन-सी विधि विशेष योग्यता / आवश्यकताओं वाले बच्चों के अध्ययन में सहायक है?
questions.explanation: The case-study method gives an in-depth study of an individual child, suited to children with special needs. (Q23 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-3.html
questions.explanationHi: व्यक्ति अध्ययन (केस स्टडी) विधि से किसी एक बालक का गहन अध्ययन होता है।

questions.text: A prejudgement, usually a negative attitude, that is unverified is called:
questions.textHi: सामान्यतः नकारात्मक अभिवृत्ति वाला पूर्व-निर्णय, जो असत्यापित होता है, क्या कहलाता है?
questions.explanation: A prejudice is an unverified, usually negative prejudgement. (Q24 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-3.html
questions.explanationHi: पूर्वाग्रह बिना जाँचा, प्रायः नकारात्मक पूर्व-निर्णय है।

questions.text: Mental structure that guides social (and other) cognition is called -
questions.textHi: एक मानसिक संरचना जो सामाजिक (तथा अन्य) संज्ञान को निर्देशित करती है, क्या कहलाती है?
questions.explanation: A schema is a mental structure that organises and guides social cognition. (Q25 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-3.html
questions.explanationHi: स्कीमा एक मानसिक संरचना है जो सामाजिक संज्ञान को निर्देशित करती है।

questions.text: ‘Electra Complex' was proposed by-
questions.textHi: ‘इलैक्ट्रा कॉम्पलेक्स’ प्रतिपादित किया
questions.explanation: Carl Jung proposed the term Electra complex (1913) as the female counterpart of the Oedipus complex. (Q26 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-3.html
questions.explanationHi: कार्ल युंग ने ओडिपस ग्रंथि के स्त्री समरूप के रूप में इलेक्ट्रा ग्रंथि शब्द दिया।

questions.text: Which of the following is not a type of 'Psychophysical Method of study of 'Educational Psychology'?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी ‘शिक्षा मनोविज्ञान’ के अध्ययन की ‘मनोभौतिकीय विधि’ नहीं है?
options: The method of minimal changes or method of limits
The method of average or mean error
The method of Modifying the individual attitude
optionsHi: न्यूनतम परिवर्तन की विधि अथवा सीमा की विधि
औसत अथवा माध्य त्रुटि की विधि
व्यक्तिगत अभिवृत्ति को संशोधित करने की विधि
questions.explanation: The classical psychophysical methods are limits, constant stimuli and average error; modifying attitudes is not one. (Q27 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-3.html
questions.explanationHi: मनोभौतिकीय विधियाँ सीमा विधि, स्थिर उद्दीपक विधि और औसत त्रुटि विधि हैं।

questions.text: Which of the following is not a type of positive transfer of learning?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा अधिगम के धनात्मक स्थानांतरण का प्रकार नहीं है?
questions.explanation: Zero transfer means no effect of earlier learning, so it is not positive transfer. (Q28 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-3.html
questions.explanationHi: शून्य स्थानांतरण में पूर्व अधिगम का कोई प्रभाव नहीं होता, अतः यह धनात्मक नहीं है।

questions.text: Who stated that 'Psychology is the positive science of the conduct of living creatures'?
questions.textHi: किसने कहा कि मनोविज्ञान जीवधारियों के आचरण का धनात्मक (विधायक) विज्ञान है?
questions.explanation: William McDougall defined psychology as the positive science of the conduct of living creatures. (Q29 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-3.html
questions.explanationHi: विलियम मैक्डूगल ने मनोविज्ञान को जीवधारियों के आचरण का धनात्मक विज्ञान कहा।

questions.text: Which of the following is not a symptom of a good memory?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा अच्छी स्मृति का लक्षण नहीं है?
options: Recall of right material at right time
optionsHi: सही सामग्रीयों का सही समय पर स्मरण करना
questions.explanation: Good memory shows rapid learning, long (not average) retention, accurate and timely recall. (Q30 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-3.html
questions.explanationHi: अच्छी स्मृति में तीव्रता, दीर्घ धारण, शुद्धता और समय पर स्मरण होता है।

questions.text: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank: If it ………… (rain), we will not come to your place tonight.
questions.explanation: In a first conditional, the if-clause takes the simple present: "If it rains, we will not come." (Q31 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank: The picture ………… (paint) by tomorrow evening.
questions.explanation: "By tomorrow evening" needs the future perfect passive: "will have been painted". (Q32 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank: I took ………… Tom at chess and beat him.
questions.explanation: "Take on" means to compete against someone. (Q33 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: He is good ………… singing.
questions.explanation: "Good at" is the correct collocation for skills. (Q34 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Maharani Laxmi Bai never laid ………… her arms.
questions.explanation: "Lay down arms" means to surrender. (Q35 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the meaning of the idiom: A jaundiced eye
questions.explanation: A jaundiced eye means a prejudiced, unfavourable view. (Q37 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the meaning of the idiom: To get into hot water
options: To suffer a huge financial loss
to get in a confused state of mind
questions.explanation: "To get into hot water" means to get into trouble. (Q38 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Give one word for: One who is expert in public speaking.
questions.explanation: An orator is a skilled public speaker. (Q39 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct antonym of: PRODIGAL
questions.explanation: Prodigal means wasteful; its antonym is careful (thrifty). (Q40 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct antonym of: MACABRE
questions.explanation: Macabre means gruesome; attractive is its opposite. (Q41 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym of: MONOTONOUS
questions.explanation: Monotonous means dull and tedious. (Q42 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym of: BOUNTY
questions.explanation: Bounty means a generous gift or reward. (Q43 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: The masculine of "DUCK" is:
questions.explanation: A male duck is a drake. (Q44 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correctly spelt word:

questions.text: When was the princely state of Bilaspur merged with HP?
questions.textHi: बिलासपुर रियासत का हिमाचल प्रदेश में विलय कब हुआ?
questions.explanation: Bilaspur was merged with Himachal Pradesh on 1 July 1954. (Q140 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-14.html
questions.explanationHi: बिलासपुर का हिमाचल प्रदेश में विलय 1 जुलाई 1954 को हुआ।

questions.text: Who invaded Kangra in 1805 AD?
questions.textHi: 1805 ई० में कांगड़ा पर किसने आक्रमण किया?
questions.explanation: The Gorkha general Amar Singh Thapa invaded Kangra in 1805-06. (Q141 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-15.html
questions.explanationHi: गोरखा सेनापति अमर सिंह थापा ने 1805-06 में कांगड़ा पर आक्रमण किया।

questions.text: The famous Shoolini Devi temple is located at:
questions.textHi: प्रसिद्ध ‘शूलिनी देवी’ का मन्दिर कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The Shoolini Devi temple is in Solan; the town is named after the goddess. (Q143 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-15.html
questions.explanationHi: शूलिनी देवी मंदिर सोलन में है; शहर का नाम देवी के नाम पर है।

questions.text: The famous firing episode of the 'Dhami' princely state took place in:
questions.textHi: प्रदेश की ‘धामी’ रियासत का प्रसिद्ध गोली कांड कब हुआ?
questions.explanation: The Dhami firing took place on 16 July 1939. (Q144 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-15.html
questions.explanationHi: धामी गोलीकांड 16 जुलाई 1939 को हुआ।

questions.text: At present (2022), the education minister of Himachal Pradesh is:
questions.textHi: वर्तमान (2022) में हिमाचल प्रदेश के शिक्षा मंत्री हैं:
questions.explanation: Govind Singh Thakur was HP's education minister in 2022. (Q146 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-15.html
questions.explanationHi: गोविंद सिंह ठाकुर 2022 में हि.प्र. के शिक्षा मंत्री थे।

questions.text: Which sage is worshipped in Sirmour?
questions.textHi: सिरमौर में किस ऋषि की पूजा की जाती है?
questions.explanation: Sage Jamadagni, husband of Renuka, is worshipped in Sirmour (Renuka ji). (Q147 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-15.html
questions.explanationHi: रेणुका के पति ऋषि जमदग्नि की सिरमौर (रेणुका जी) में पूजा होती है।

questions.text: When was President’s Rule imposed in Himachal Pradesh?
questions.textHi: हिमाचल प्रदेश में राष्ट्रपति शासन कब लागू हुआ?
questions.explanation: President's Rule was imposed in HP on 15 December 1992. (Q148 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-15.html
questions.explanationHi: हिमाचल में 15 दिसंबर 1992 को राष्ट्रपति शासन लगा।

questions.text: Union Minister Anurag Thakur (2022) holds which of the following portfolios?
questions.textHi: केन्द्रीय मंत्री अनुराग ठाकुर निम्न में से कौन-सा पोर्टफोलियो संभालते हैं?
questions.explanation: In 2022 Anurag Thakur was Union Minister of Information & Broadcasting (and Sports). (Q149 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-15.html
questions.explanationHi: 2022 में अनुराग ठाकुर केंद्रीय सूचना एवं प्रसारण (तथा खेल) मंत्री थे।

questions.text: Who led the Quit India Movement in Shimla?
questions.textHi: शिमला में ‘भारत छोड़ो आन्दोलन’ का नेतृत्व किसने किया?
questions.explanation: Rajkumari Amrit Kaur led the Quit India Movement in Shimla (1942). (Q150 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2023/01/hp-tet-arts-june-2022-paper-part-15.html
questions.explanationHi: राजकुमारी अमृत कौर ने शिमला में भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन का नेतृत्व किया।
